deathrestart.death_broadcast: %s died! The world will reset in %s seconds.
deathrestart.reconnect.title: Resetting World
deathrestart.reconnect.waiting: The host is generating a new world. Reconnecting soon…
deathrestart.reconnect.timeout: Reconnect timed out. Rejoin from the multiplayer list.
deathrestart.reset.saving: Saving the old world and generating a new one…
deathrestart.reset.old_world_kept: The old world is still in its original save folder.
deathrestart.reset.old_world_restored: The old world was restored. Reopen the original save to continue.
deathrestart.reset.port_wait: New world generated. Waiting for original port %s to be released; retrying soon…
deathrestart.config.title: Death Restart Settings
deathrestart.config.scope: The host controls reset rules and the leaderboard. Reconnect options apply to this guest only.
deathrestart.config.reset_countdown.tool: Host setting: duration used for the next player death. An active countdown is not affected.
Guest setting: automatically rejoin the original address after the host announces a world reset. Applies to the next reset.
deathrestart.config.reconnect_interval.t: Guest setting: delay before the first connection and minimum time between later attempts. An ongoing connection is allowed to finish before retrying.
deathrestart.config.reconnect_timeout.to: Guest setting: maximum wait after disconnecting. After a timeout, rejoin from the multiplayer list.
deathrestart.config.death_leaderboard.to: Host setting: deaths are still counted while hidden. Turning this off restores the sidebar replaced by the leaderboard, if that objective still exists.
deathrestart.config.backup_port_note: Every reset keeps an old-world backup and reuses the original LAN port.
deathrestart.config.save_failed_details: Could not write config/deathrestart.json. Your changes have not been applied. Check that the game folder is writable, then try again.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.deathrest: In LAN multiplayer, a player death starts a countdown, then rebuilds the world with a new seed on the same port. Includes a cumulative death leaderboard, auto-reconnect, and a configurable countdown.
deathrestart.config.statistics_mode.tool: Host setting: Player Name mode is case-insensitive and merges identical names. UUID mode tracks by account across name changes. Stored separately; switching will not merge data.
deathrestart.command.not_lan: Please open the world to LAN before using reset commands.
deathrestart.command.invalid_countdown: Countdown must be one of: 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 45, or 60 seconds.
deathrestart.command.save_failed: Failed to save settings; no changes were applied.
deathrestart.command.restart_broadcast: The host initiated a manual reset. The world will reset in %s seconds.
deathrestart.command.restart_confirmatio: Manual reset prepared. Confirming will start a %s-second countdown. Run /deathrestart restart confirm within 60 seconds.
There is no valid manual reset request. Run /deathrestart restart [seconds] again.
A manual reset is already awaiting confirmation. Run /deathrestart restart confirm or /deathrestart cancel first.
deathrestart.command.already_scheduled: A world reset is already counting down: %s seconds remaining.
deathrestart.command.reset_started: World reset has already started and cannot be cancelled.
deathrestart.command.cancelled: The host cancelled the world reset.
deathrestart.command.no_countdown: There is no pending world reset.
deathrestart.command.status_idle: No world reset is currently scheduled.
deathrestart.command.status_confirmation: Awaiting manual reset confirmation (%s-second countdown after confirmation).
deathrestart.command.status_details: Identity Mode: %s · Leaderboard: %s · Port: %s · Account Authentication: %s
deathrestart.command.leaderboard_enabled: Death leaderboard is now visible to everyone. Deaths will continue to be counted.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard_disable: Death leaderboard is now hidden from everyone. Deaths will continue to be counted.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard.clear_p: This will clear both player-name and UUID death statistics for this save. This cannot be undone. Run /deathrestart leaderboard clear confirm within 60 seconds.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard.clear_e: No valid leaderboard clear request. Run /deathrestart leaderboard clear again.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard.cleared: Player-name and UUID death statistics for this save have been cleared. Online players start again at 0.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard.clear_f: Could not clear the leaderboard. Statistics were not cleared. Check the statistics file and game folder write permissions. See the game logs for details.
deathrestart.command.countdown_updated: Default reset countdown updated to %s seconds. Takes effect on the next death.
